subject: Arcadia onboarding deep-dive — alternate time / shorter API block
messages:
From: Leah Park <leah.park@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 2-hour onboarding deep-dive for Arcadia (console + API)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The engineering and product adoption teams want a focused onboarding session so they can start building with Redwood quickly. High level ask: a 2-hour deep-dive covering 45m console walkthrough (model selection, rollout, monitoring) + 75m hands-on API enablement (auth, streaming, batching, example prompts).

Attendees: 6 engineers + 2 product managers (mostly PST). Preferred windows: 9:00–12:00 PDT on Tue/Wed/Thu the week of May 24th. If we need to split into two shorter sessions, we can do 60m console + 60m API on separate days.

Could you propose 2–3 slots and share any prep checklist so the team can get credentials and sample prompts ready?

Attachment: Arcadia_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (PDF, 312KB)

Best,
Leah Park
Head of Integrations
Arcadia HealthTech
leah.park@arcadiahealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-hour onboarding deep-dive for Arcadia (console + API)

Leah —

Thanks — happy to run this. Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Wed May 26, 09:30–11:30 (2h)
- Thu May 27, 10:00–12:00 (2h)
- Tue May 25, 09:00–10:00 (console) + Tue May 25, 11:00–12:00 (API) if you want same-day split

Prep I can share: a short checklist (attached) and a repo with example prompts. Also looping in Marissa to own the console walkthrough and Priyom to lead the API hands‑on.

Marissa — can you confirm you can do the console portion on any of these slots? Priyom — please confirm availability for the API block.

I attached the Arcadia checklist and an .ics I’ll use once you pick a time.

Attachments: Arcadia_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (PDF, 312KB)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Leah Park <leah.park@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-hour onboarding deep-dive for Arcadia (console + API)

Jordan —

Appreciate the options. Quick note: the engineering lead is out Wed/Thu morning — our best window is Tue May 25 but they prefer a single continuous block no earlier than 11:00 PDT. Would you be able to run a 2-hour session Tue May 25, 11:00–13:00? If not, we will take Tue split 60/60 as backup.

Also, could we shorten the API hands‑on to ~60m focused on auth, streaming, and a short walkthrough of batching heuristics? The team has basic familiarity and wants more time on troubleshooting and KV/prefix caching examples.

If it's easier, feel free to reassign the API part to Priyom entirely — he can go deep on prompts and batching.

Thanks — I can confirm attendees once we lock the slot.

Best,
Leah

Date: 2027-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-hour onboarding deep-dive for Arcadia (console + API)

Leah / Jordan —

We can accommodate Tue May 25, 11:00–13:00 PDT as a single session. Per Leah’s note, we’ll compress the API hands‑on to ~60 minutes focusing on auth, streaming, and batching heuristics + a short troubleshooting checklist. Priyom will run the API portion and follow up with the sample prompts repo and an optional follow-up lab if you want it.

I just sent the calendar invite (attached .ics) and included a short agenda:
- 11:00–11:10 — Introductions & goals
- 11:10–11:50 — Console: model selection, rollouts, monitoring (Marissa)
- 11:50–12:50 — API hands‑on: auth, streaming, batching, KV caching examples (Priyom)
- 12:50–13:00 — Q&A & next steps

Pre-reqs: everyone should have a Redwood account and API key (see checklist). If anyone needs onboarding access, reply-all and Jordan will fast-track invites.

Attachments: training-invite.ics

See you then —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
